shortDescription: Manage ACLs on a Proxmox Backup Server

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. You can also use the C(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with.

options.name: auth_id
options.description: Authentication ID to assign the ACL to. Example: C(john@pbs)

options.name: propagate
options.description: Propagate this ACL so subdirectories (inherit this ACL)

options.name: role
options.description: Role name to be assigned to the ACL. Example: DatastoreAdmin

options.name: state
options.description: Whether this ACL should be C(present) or C(absent)

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate SSL certificate of the PVE host upon connecting
